title: Cookie Policy
intro: Cookie controls are available at first visit. Analytics tags load only after you accept analytics cookies.

sections.heading: Necessary Cookies
paragraphs: These cookies support core functionality such as essential site behavior and admin-only security state.

sections.heading: Analytics Cookies (Consent Required in EU/UK)
paragraphs: We use Google Analytics with Consent Mode v2: analytics_storage defaults to denied until you opt in via the banner. Analytics cookies help us understand non-personal engagement patterns and improve conversion flows.
